title: Model for active-active CRDB semantics, not single-primary
intent: Checks the answer describes CRDB as active-active with conflict-free replicated semantics rather than single-primary strong consistency, and keeps the CRDB on database-0 semantics.
prompt: Review this data model for an active geo-replicated (CRDB) Azure Managed Redis deployment and correct the consistency and database assumptions.

input_artifacts.name: crdb-model.txt
input_artifacts.content: assumption: 'the CRDB is a strongly consistent single-primary store'; design: read-modify-write counters expecting linearizable ordering; also spreads data across databases 0 through 4 in the CRDB

embedded_defects.defect: Assumes single-primary strong consistency instead of active-active conflict-free replicated semantics.
Spreads data across multiple databases in a CRDB that uses database-0 semantics.
